cohort: 100 women undergoing primary cesarean section and 100 women undergoing one or more repeat cesarean sections at Jubilee Mission Hospital, Thrissur from March 2014 to March 2015
finding: Repeat cesarean sections are associated with a higher rate of complications, including adhesions, thin lower uterine segment, extension of uterine incision, placenta accreta, and obstetric hysterectomy.
